notes: No website in the seed list; the county site co.hudspeth.tx.us (https) has 'Elections 2025-2026' and 'Elections Results 2025 and Earlier' pages listing Hart InterCivic report PDFs. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The server gives real per-file Last-Modified values (they differ by file and match file-name stamps), so upload times are usable. Hudspeth is Mountain time: MST (UTC-7) in Nov and Mar, MDT (UTC-6) in May. The Elections Home page also points to state-wide results (results.texas-election.com). Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not found on origin).
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER by check 2 (no precinct numbers with election-day votes posted on election night), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; confidence med because the 2026 primary night reports carry both printed run times and election-night upload times.
